   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      8 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 06.05.2026 - 09.10.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Dustin Mallory_, 07.10.2026, 1/5: "This app used to be amazing until they replaced their previous intuitive user interface with this AI Slop. After 10 seconds of you can tell that, that is clearly what this is. Absolutely no thought put into the usability of the UI whatsoever. Or if there was, it was whatever ChatGPT thought would be most usable. It's unusable now in its current state. I guess I'll be switching to another app."
            2. _Thorsten Mootz_, 30.08.2026, 1/5: "Neues Update ist ganz schlimm und benutzerunfreundlich. If it's not broken, don't fix it..."
            3. _Harun_, 04.08.2026, 1/5: "I have been using this app for more than 10 years now. In the beginning it was the perfect app. But it is too laggy/buggy now. And also there is too much downtime lately. Other than that still an ok app to track macro's. UPDATE: THE LATEST UPDATE ON ANDROID SUCKS UNFORTUNATELY. I CAN'T DELETE A WHOLE MEAL AT ONCE ANYMORY, ALSO DON'T HAVE AN OVERVIEW OF MY MEALS LIKE ON THE WEB VERSION. I'M A PREMIUM USER AND I SERIOUSLY CONSIDER CANCELING MY SUBSCRIPTION! HOPE THIS WILL BE FIXED ASAP!"
